analysis: Both units are BASE-side excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 3591-4070). They contain tensor-parallel, placement, share-probe, served-speed, GLM TP and prefill documentation and are not changed lines. The PR patch is documentation-only: the date bump at line 3; a paragraph at head 3528-3536 on the cluster service health file (DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_MEMBER_HEALTH_FILE, service-health.json versus part-health.json, so a coordinator-paired part does not overwrite the service heartbeat and the supervisor liveness guard still requires the service's own PID); and a head 5230-5235 edit saying signed releases compute and register cluster_runtime approval digests from their final app. No code, control or trust-boundary behavior changes in the supplied evidence. Relevant threat-model areas are TB-002 and TB-003 (provider and operator trust), T-041 (prefix cache) and T-034/T-054 (build identity and qualification), but nothing in the supplied text weakens them. The unit text cited by base line numbers touches no new attack surface, and the described prefix-cache scoping and encrypted SSD tiers match the existing T-041 posture. Open integration questions, outside the supplied evidence: (1) the health-file path change in ClusterServiceAgent and ClusterService.partEnvironment (whether health paths are owner-only, and whether the PID-check guard is preserved) and (2) the release-lane computation and registration of cluster_runtime digests in the backend or release tooling. These are not verifiable from the supplied excerpts, so no findings are recorded; the source code for those behaviors was not supplied.
